description: State of a connection or integration, with options to connect, manage or remove.

howToUse: Use it on integrations pages: one card per service, with its state and what it does.
Put the service logo in `logo`, the state in `status`, and "Connect" or "Configure" in `actions`.
Use `locked` with `lockHint` when the plan does not include the integration; keep the upgrade button working.
Your application runs the sign-in with the service.
alternatives: Signing in to the app with an account: OAuthButton.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions of the card.

props.name: logo
props.description:
Service logo (slot: the service's real SVG, never bundled in the DS).
Rendered in a 40px square with a neutral border.

props.name: description
props.description: Short description of what the integration does.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono metadata line (account, number of sites, last sync).

props.name: locked
props.description:
Locked by plan (upsell): dimmed surface; `lockHint` replaces
the actions (e.g. `Badge` "Growth plan" + upgrade `Button`).

props.name: lockHint
props.description: Content shown in place of the actions when `locked`.
